the_force.description: The Force is an energy field created by all living things. It surrounds us, penetrates us, and binds the galaxy together. It has two primary aspects: the Light Side and the Dark Side.

light_side.description: The Light Side represents peace, knowledge, tranquility, selflessness, and defense. Jedi use the Light Side for knowledge and defense, never for attack.
tenets: There is no emotion, there is peace
There is no passion, there is serenity
There is no chaos, there is harmony
There is no death, there is the Force

dark_side.description: The Dark Side represents passion, aggression, power, fear, and hatred. It is quicker, easier, and more seductive, but leads to corruption and destruction.
tenets: Passion, which the light side does not understand, leads to power
Only then can the Republic be rebuilt
practices: Pursuit of personal power at any cost
Rejection of death through forbidden knowledge
dark_side.warning: Fear leads to anger. Anger leads to hate. Hate leads to suffering. This is the path to the Dark Side.

force_abilities.telekinesis: Moving objects with the mind — push, pull, lift, throw
force_abilities.force_push: Explosive kinetic blast to knock back opponents
force_abilities.force_pull: Drawing objects or beings toward the user
force_abilities.force_choke: Crushing a target's throat from a distance (Dark Side)
force_abilities.force_lightning: Bolt of raw Dark Side energy that inflicts agony (Dark Side)
force_abilities.force_heal: Healing wounds and ailments through the Light Side
force_abilities.force_speed: Enhancing physical speed beyond normal limits
force_abilities.force_sense: Sensing disturbances, emotions, and presences in the Force
force_abilities.force_vision: Seeing possible futures or distant events
force_abilities.force_ghost: Projecting one's consciousness after death (mastered by Yoda, Obi-Wan, Qui-Gon)
force_abilities.force_barrier: Creating a protective barrier of Force energy
force_abilities.force_drown: Suffocating a target by filling their lungs with water (Dark Side)
force_abilities.sith_alchemy: Forbidden Dark Side knowledge to cheat death (Darth Plagueis)
force_abilities.force_dyad: An extremely rare connection between two Force-sensitives who share a bond across any distance (Rey and Kylo Ren)

midichlorians.description: Microscopic lifeforms that reside within all cells and communicate the will of the Force. The concentration of midichlorians in one's blood measures Force sensitivity.

eras.name: The Old Republic
eras.description: The ancient era of the Jedi-Sith Wars. The Republic and the Jedi Order fought against the Sith for millennia. The Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War (Jedi vs Sith under Darth Malak) occurred during this period.
key_events: Rising of the Sith (c. 6900 BBY)
New Sith Wars (c. 2000-1000 BBY)
HolocronEra
eras.jedi_status: Jedi Order at its height, thousands of Jedi
eras.sith_status: Multiple Sith Lords, not yet following Rule of Two

eras.name: The High Republic
eras.description: A golden age of the Jedi Order and the Republic. The Jedi were explorers and heroes. The Nihil pirates and the ancient Sith Eternal cult under Darth Sidious threatened this era.
key_events: Starlight Beacon construction
Nihil pirate attacks
Fall of the Jedi Temple (Great Hyperspace Disaster)
Darth Bane's Rule of Two established in shadows
eras.jedi_status: Golden age — Jedi at their most numerous and confident
eras.sith_status: Darth Sidious begins his rise; Sith Eternal hidden on Exegol

eras.name: The Prequel Era (Clone Wars)
eras.description: The era of the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist Alliance. Secretly orchestrated by Darth Sidious (Palpatine) to destroy the Jedi and seize power. Began with the Battle of Geonosis and ended with Order 66.
key_events: Battle of Geonosis (32 BBY) — Start of the Clone Wars
Battle of Christophsis (21 BBY)
Battle of Utapau (19 BBY) — Death of General Grievous
Battle of Mustafar (19 BBY) — Anakin's fall, death of Dooku
Order 66 (19 BBY) — Near-extinction of the Jedi
Rise of the Galactic Empire (19 BBY)
eras.sith_status: Darth Sidious becomes Emperor; Darth Vader as apprentice

eras.name: The Original Trilogy Era
eras.description: The era of the Galactic Empire's rule and the Rebel Alliance's fight for freedom. Darth Vader hunts the remaining Jedi while the Rebellion grows. Culminates in the destruction of the Empire at Endor.
key_events: Construction of the Death Star (18 BBY - 0 BBY)
Battle of Yavin (0 BBY) — Destruction of the first Death Star
Construction of Echo Base on Hoth (3 ABY)
Battle of Hoth (3 ABY) — Rebel retreat
Rescue of Han Solo from Jabba (4 ABY)
Battle of Endor (4 ABY) — Destruction of the second Death Star, death of Vader and Palpatine
Birth of the New Republic (5 ABY)
eras.jedi_status: Luke Skywalker begins Jedi training; Order nearly extinct
eras.sith_status: Darth Vader and Palpatine destroyed at Endor

eras.name: The New Republic Era
eras.description: The period after the Empire's fall. The New Republic is established, but political complacency leads to military disarmament. Luke attempts to restore the Jedi Order but abandons it after Ben Solo's fall. The First Order rises in secret.
key_events: Establishment of the New Republic (5 ABY)
Luke Skywalker begins Jedi Academy (18 ABY)
Ben Solo's fall to the Dark Side (25 ABY)
Destruction of Luke's Jedi Temple (25 ABY)
Rise of the First Order in secret (25-34 ABY)
Leia Organa founds the Resistance (34 ABY)
eras.jedi_status: Luke's new Jedi Order destroyed; Luke goes into exile
eras.sith_status: Sith appear extinct; First Order uses Dark Side acolytes

eras.name: The Sequel Trilogy Era
eras.description: The era of the First Order's rise and the Resistance's fight against them. Rey discovers her connection to the Force and the Skywalker legacy. Palpatine returns from the dead via the Sith Eternal.
key_events: Starkiller Base destroys the Hosnian System (34 ABY)
Battle of Starkiller Base (34 ABY)
Search for Luke Skywalker (34 ABY)
Battle of Crait (34 ABY)
Ben Solo's redemption and death (34 ABY)
Rise of the Resistance (35 ABY)
Return of Emperor Palpatine via Sith Eternal (35 ABY)
Battle of Exegol (35 ABY) — Final defeat of Palpatine and the Sith Eternal
Rey burns the Skywalker lightsabers and is acknowledged as Rey Skywalker
eras.jedi_status: Rey begins to restore the Jedi Order
eras.sith_status: Palpatine and the Sith Eternal destroyed at Exegol

planets.name: Tatooine
planets.description: A twin-sunned desert planet and a crossroads of the Outer Rim. Home to the Skywalker family and a hub for smugglers and slavers.
planets.significance: Birthplace of Anakin Skywalker; hiding place of Luke; where Obi-Wan watched over Luke

planets.name: Coruscant
planets.description: The capital world of the galaxy. A completely urbanized planet serving as the seat of the Republic, the Empire, and later the New Republic.
planets.significance: Galactic capital; home of the Jedi Temple; center of political power

planets.name: Naboo
planets.description: A peaceful, beautiful planet with lush grasslands, oceans, and Gungan underwater cities. Home of Queen/Senator Leia Organa's political mentor, Queen Amidala.
planets.significance: Homeworld of Palpatine (secretly) and Queen Amidala; site of the Trade Federation invasion

planets.name: Hoth
planets.description: A frozen ice planet where the Rebel Alliance established Echo Base. The harsh environment provided cover but also vulnerability.
planets.significance: Site of the Battle of Hoth; Rebel evacuation led to the search for a new base

planets.name: Dagobah
planets.description: A dark, swampy planet hidden in a nebula. Yoda's place of exile for 1,000 years. Luke Skywalker trained here to become a Jedi.
planets.significance: Luke's Jedi training ground; Yoda's exile; site of Luke's cave trial

planets.name: Endor
planets.description: A forest moon with a primitive Ewok population. The second Death Star was constructed in orbit above it.
planets.significance: Site of the final battle of the Original Trilogy; death of Palpatine and Vader

planets.name: Mustafar
planets.description: A volcanic lava world and mining planet. Site of the duel between Obi-Wan and Anakin, where Anakin was burned and became Darth Vader.
planets.significance: Anakin's fall to the Dark Side; birth of Darth Vader; end of the Clone Wars

planets.name: Kashyyyk
planets.description: A forested planet and homeworld of the Wookiees. Loyal to the Republic during the Clone Wars. Suffered a massacre under the Empire.
planets.significance: Homeworld of Chewbacca; site of Imperial massacre; Wookiee alliance with the Rebellion

planets.name: Geonosis
planets.description: A desert planet and the birthplace of the Clone Wars. Home to the Geonosians who manufactured droids for the Separatists.
planets.significance: First battle of the Clone Wars; where the Jedi were nearly killed in the arena

planets.name: Yavin 4
planets.description: A gas giant whose fourth moon houses the ancient Massassi Temple. The Rebel Alliance established its first major base here after escaping the Death Star.
planets.significance: First major Rebel base; site of planning for the Battle of Yavin

planets.name: Ahch-To
planets.description: A remote ocean planet where the first Jedi Temple was built. Luke Skywalker went into exile here after the fall of Ben Solo.
planets.significance: The first Jedi Temple; Luke's exile; where Rey found Luke to ask him to restore the Jedi

planets.name: Exegol
planets.description: A dark, remote planet where the Sith Eternal cult survived for centuries. Emperor Palpatine's place of resurrection and final stand.
planets.significance: Palpatine's return; the final battle of the Sequel Trilogy; destruction of the Sith Eternal

planets.name: Jakku
planets.description: A desert planet covered in wreckage from the Battle of Jakku. Rey grew up as a scavenger here before discovering her Force sensitivity.
planets.significance: Site of the last major battle between the First Order and Resistance; Rey's homeworld

planets.name: Kamino
planets.description: An ocean planet where the clone army was created from Jango Fett's DNA. Hidden from the Republic until the Jedi discovered it.
planets.significance: Creation of the Clone Army; Jango Fett's death; origin of Boba Fett

species.name: Humans
species.description: The most widespread species in the galaxy. Dominant in politics and military. Include the Skywalker, Organa, and Solo families.

species.name: Wookiees
species.description: Tall, hairy humanoids from Kashyyyk. Known for their strength, loyalty, and honor. Bound by a ancient pact to the Humans of Corellia.

species.name: Yoda's Species
species.description: A small, long-lived species with immense Force sensitivity. Yoda is the only named member. Their homeworld and species name are unknown.

species.name: Twileks
species.description: Humanoids with distinctive head-tails (lekku). Often found as slaves or in the entertainment industry, but also as warriors and leaders.

species.name: Togruta
species.description: Humanoids with colorful skin patterns and head-tufts (krayt). Strong Force sensitivity. Ahsoka Tano is the most famous.

species.name: Droids
species.description: Sentient mechanical beings ranging from simple astromechs to complex battle droids. Their sentience is debated and often denied by their creators.

species.name: Ewoks
species.description: Small, primitive but clever forest dwellers of Endor. Used primitive weapons and traps to help the Rebels defeat the Empire.

species.name: Hutts
species.description: Massive, slug-like crime lords who rule vast criminal empires from the Outer Rim. Known for their gluttony, cruelty, and wealth.

species.name: Trandoshans
species.description: Reptilian humanoids known for their hunting skills and bounty hunting. Cold-blooded and ruthless.

species.name: Gungans
species.description: Amphibious humanoids who live in underwater cities on Naboo. Initially at odds with Naboo humans but later allied.

species.name: Zabrak
species.description: Humanoids with horn-like protrusions and sometimes tattooed skin. Known for their resilience and pain tolerance.

species.name: Mandalorians
species.description: A warrior culture (not a species) known for their armor, combat skills, and code. Wear distinctive beskar armor.

key_events.name: The Creation of the Sith
key_events.description: Force-sensitive exiles from the Jedi Order discovered the Dark Side and created the Sith order, beginning millennia of Jedi-Sith conflict.

key_events.name: Darth Bane's Rule of Two
key_events.description: Darth Bane reformed the Sith after near-extinction, establishing the Rule of Two: only one Master and one Apprentice at a time.

key_events.name: The Clone Wars
key_events.description: A galaxy-wide conflict between the Republic and the Separatists, secretly orchestrated by Darth Sidious to destroy both the Jedi and the Republic.

key_events.name: Order 66
key_events.description: The kill order that turned the Clone Army against the Jedi, nearly exterminating the order. Executed through inhibitor chips in clone troopers.

key_events.name: Rise of the Galactic Empire
key_events.description: Palpatine transformed the Republic into the Galactic Empire, declaring himself Emperor and beginning decades of tyranny.

key_events.name: The Destruction of the First Death Star
key_events.description: Luke Skywalker, guided by the Force, fired proton torpedoes into the Death Star's thermal exhaust port, destroying the superweapon.

key_events.name: The Battle of Hoth
key_events.description: The Empire destroyed Echo Base, forcing the Rebels into a desperate retreat. Han Solo and Leia fled on the Millennium Falcon.

key_events.name: The Battle of Endor
key_events.description: The Rebels destroyed the second Death Star, killed Emperor Palpatine, and saw Darth Vader redeem himself by saving Luke. The Empire fell.

key_events.name: The Return of Palpatine
key_events.description: Emperor Palpatine returned from the dead via Sith alchemy on Exegol, leading the Sith Eternal and the Final Order fleet.

key_events.name: The Battle of Exegol
key_events.description: Rey, with the help of the Resistance and the Force ghosts of past Jedi, defeated Palpatine and destroyed the Sith Eternal fleet. The Sith were finally vanquished.

lightsabers.description: A lightsaber is a weapon that produces a blade of pure energy from a Kyber crystal. It is the signature weapon of the Jedi and Sith.

kyber_crystals.description: Sentient crystals that bond with their Force-sensitive wielder. Naturally clear, they 'turn' green or blue when bonded with a Jedi. Sith must force-bind a crystal, causing it to 'bleed' red.

colors.blue: Jedi Guardian — balance of combat and Force abilities
colors.green: Jedi Consular — stronger connection to the Force
colors.red: Sith/Dark Side — forced crystal 'bleeding' through pain and hatred
colors.yellow: Jedi Temple Guard / Rey — balance of Guardian and Consular
colors.purple: Mace Windu — unique, representing his use of Dark Side techniques (Vaapad) while remaining Light Side
colors.white: Ahsoka Tano — purified crystals, neither Light nor Dark
colors.black: Sith Holocron — rare, associated with the Darksaber (Mandalorian weapon)

darksaber.description: A unique black-bladed lightsaber created by Tarre Vizsla, the first Mandalorian Jedi. Its ownership is determined by Mandalorian custom — it must be won in combat, not given.
